Porsche 911 Turbo (930)

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1049043-porsche-911-turbo-930#profileId-1035371

Here is my New Model. Porsche 911 Turbo Model 930.

 

The body has been redesigned to be printed as one piece, thus getting the best possible surface area

Easy to print.

Use Glue.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.16mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.16 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#000000), PLA (#D02727), PLA (#C8C8C8), PETG (#FF911A80)
